name: code-review
description: /code-review skill: reviews the work in progress, or a PR number, revision range or path, for correctness bugs and broken repository rules. Works with Git, Mercurial, Subversion, Perforce and Jujutsu, and with workspaces that combine them, following what the repository README says about its VCS. An effort level (low to max) sets how many finder subagents explore; a separate verifier subagent then checks each candidate before it is reported. --fix applies the findings, --comment posts them to the PR, --max-findings changes the cap.
